formal_case.note: The formal Air case's three Opportunity Spaces and its one recommendation - kept separate from the general innovation population above, never a tournament over it.
formal_case.recommended_name: Reliability-Verified Air Purifiers (extended-life guarantee + real-time self-diagnostic)
formal_case.why: Neither dominates outright — Pain + Feasibility majority rule selected Reliability-Verified Air Purifiers.
formal_case.first_experiment: Cross-reference the real review corpus's product-level failure mentions ('stopped working', 'died', 'never worked') against each real product's rating_number (a rough popularity proxy) to identify whether failure reports cluster in specific brands/price tiers or are evenly distributed - if evenly distributed, this is a category-wide manufacturing/QA opportunity; if clustered, it may instead argue for a narrower positioning bet against the worst-performing competitors specifically.
formal_case.abandon_signal: If the failure-mention cross-reference above shows reliability complaints concentrated in 2-3 specific older/discontinued products rather than spread across the category, treat this as a solved-or-solving problem rather than a live opportunity, and abandon.
formal_case.most_sensitive_assumption: Switch to Economic Value override → picks Whisper-Quiet Night Mode instead.
